setup.js: (()=>{window.__avisos=[];const re=/N[ãa]o foi poss[ií]vel|Erro ao|Tente novamente|Algo deu errado|Falha ao|Something went wrong/i;const chk=(t)=>{t=(t||'').trim();const m=t&&t.match(new RegExp('[^]{0,40}('+re.source+')[^]{0,40}','i'));if(m&&window.__avisos.length<10)window.__avisos.push(m[0].replace(/[\n\r\t ]+/g,' '))};new MutationObserver(ms=>{for(const m of ms){m.addedNodes.forEach(n=>chk(n.textContent));if(m.type==='characterData')chk(m.target.textContent)}}).observe(document.body,{childList:true,subtree:true,characterData:true});chk(document.body.innerText);setInterval(()=>{document.querySelectorAll('[data-sonner-toast][data-type=error]').forEach(t=>{const s='TOAST DE ERRO: '+t.textContent.trim().slice(0,90);if(!window.__avisos.includes(s)&&window.__avisos.length<10)window.__avisos.push(s)})},300);return 1})()
